services.name: Frame_InputAndResourceService
behavior: Runs the frame-wait/resource gate and VBlank scene/resource query.
Samples the VDP status/resource state into the frame scratch buffer.
Runs the scene/resource helper sequence and waits for VBlank work before returning.

services.name: Player_TerrainEdgeProbe
behavior: Returns without publishing probes in scene state 8, without a player frame, or outside the vertical map bounds.
Samples terrain behavior entries on both sides of the player and publishes left/right stop and inner/outer probe flags.
Publishes the upward stop flag from the cell above the player while honoring the landing-state condition.

conclusion: The frame resource wait and player terrain edge probe are independent services: the former owns the VBlank/resource handshake, while the latter publishes directional terrain blocking state for later player response logic.
